an3.120:1.5: idha bhikkhave ekacco pāṇātipātā paṭivirato hoti adinnādānā paṭivirato hoti kāmesu micchācārā paṭivirato hoti
an3.120:2.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco musāvādā paṭivirato hoti pisuṇāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti pharusāya vācāya paṭivirato hoti samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti
an3.120:3.2: idha bhikkhave ekacco anabhijjhālū hoti abyāpannacitto hoti sammādiṭṭhiko hoti
